AI Marketing & n8n Automation Specialist for chill life — Potential Long-Term Partnership

Hi, I’m Beth Levis, founder of chill life, a purpose-driven lifestyle brand.

We believe happier people create healthier communities. Our apparel, products, and initiatives promote positivity, mental fitness, and meaningful real-life connection. Two key areas of our work are encouraging healthier youth sports culture and helping people take daily breaks from technology to be more present.

I’m looking for an experienced AI marketing and automation specialist who can help translate this mission into consistent storytelling, audience growth, and measurable sales.

What I’m looking to build

A coordinated marketing system using n8n and AI tools such as Claude or OpenAI to:

● Develop content grounded in our brand voice, values, and product offerings.

● Create and repurpose social posts, video scripts, and email campaigns.

● Manage a content calendar and approval process.

● Connect relevant tools across our Shopify store, email marketing, and social channels.

● Track performance and use those insights to improve campaigns.

Preserving the authenticity of chill life’s message is essential. The system should support thoughtful storytelling, with my review and approval built into the process.

Who would be a strong fit

Someone who combines technical skill with marketing judgment and has already built successful AI marketing workflows for an apparel, lifestyle, or consumer-product brand.

You should be able to show what you built, explain the strategy behind it, and share measurable results—particularly sales, conversions, customer acquisition, or repeat purchases.

An interest in positivity, mental fitness, youth sports, and building a brand with purpose would be a meaningful advantage.

Engagement and partnership

I’m open to discussing a project-based or ongoing engagement. For the right person, there may also be an opportunity to explore a longer-term strategic partnership, including potential equity tied to an agreed role, contribution, and results. Scope and compensation would be discussed together.

Please send me a private message with:

1. Relevant consumer-brand projects and the results achieved.

2. Examples of n8n and AI workflows you have built.

3. Your role in both marketing strategy and implementation.

4. How you would approach an initial project for chill life.

5. Your availability, pricing, and interest in a longer-term partnership.

Learn more about the brand: https://chill-life.com

I’m looking for someone who shares the vision and can help turn it into a disciplined, effective marketing operation.

Beth Levis
Founder, chill life

Hello @Chill-life, welcome to n8n community, I spent some time on chill-life.com before writing this, and I’ll answer your five points directly.

1. Consumer brand work and results

Most relevant: a daily reporting pipeline for a Shopify apparel brand pulling Meta, Google Ads and Shopify metrics into one view, so the founder could see spend against actual revenue each morning instead of three dashboards. That changed where budget went. Also a WooCommerce, payments and accounting reconciliation system for a retail client, and an order and follow-up system for a direct-to-consumer brand.

Being straight with you, since authenticity matters here: I have not run a content engine for a purpose-driven apparel brand specifically. I have the Shopify and ads data side, the content automation side, and the integration work that joins them. If you need someone with a proven conversion track record in lifestyle apparel, that isn’t me, and I’d rather say so now than oversell.

2. n8n and AI workflows

A content system where one input produces platform-specific captions, hooks and scripts, queued for approval before anything publishes. A document agent that extracts data, flags exceptions and waits for a human. A daily scouting system pulling and qualifying listings. An AI sales agent that qualifies inbound leads over messaging and books them in.

Common thread, and it matters here: every one has a human approval gate. I don’t build systems that publish on their own.

3. My role

Technical build plus the system design around it. I’m not a brand strategist, and I’d be wary of anyone claiming they can write chill life’s voice better than you. What I’d build holds your voice as the reference the AI works from, generates drafts, and puts them in front of you. The judgment stays yours.

4. How I’d approach an initial project

Your site isn’t the gap. The resources hub, the partners, the culture locker and sports culture reset are all there and they’re good. The gap is cadence and reuse.

You have four distinct audiences on that page, athletes, coaches, parents and customers, and your community spotlight shows real people already creating content for you. Right now that lives on Instagram and stops there. A single piece from the culture locker should be producing a post for each of those four audiences, an email, and a blog entry, not one Instagram post.

So the first project: a content engine that takes one source input, a story, a partner launch, a resource, and produces the full set across channels, segmented by audience, all waiting for your approval. Plus the measurement side connected to Shopify so you can see which stories actually move product rather than guessing.

5. Availability, pricing, partnership

Available now, 25 to 30 hours a week, GMT+1 with full US overlap. Project based to start, I’d want to deliver something working before either of us talks about ongoing.

A first build of this shape runs $1,200 to $2,000 depending on how many channels we connect in phase one. Retainer after that if it’s working.

On equity, open to it later, but not instead of payment on the first project. Let’s see how we work together first.
